node.title: Re^3: JSON::Path and node iteration (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I think that my values are in the first element of the array because of the selector $.author here

Ah yes, I didn't play around with [mod://JSON::Path] because I haven't used that yet (and it seemed like it might be a little overkill in this case). Anyway, I think then my unfoldauthors3 should do what you want? (Update: The same $data_ar = $data_ar->[0]; step will probably be necessary with $authors.)

Update 2: I took a look at the source of [mod://REST::Client::CrossRef], and it seems like that's the code that wraps the argument of the callback in an extra arrayref. In unfoldauthors3, you could probably just say @{$authors->[0]} instead of @$authors.
